name: agent-conversation
description: v6 agent eval, deploy posture. Every probe forces deploy mode so BYOK providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) and local Ollama under forceDeploy run against the same tool set (lookupConcept, searchJobs, matchProfile, compareRoles). Axes covered: multi-tool chains, concept-id discipline, profile-aware reasoning, adversarial / out-of-scope queries, tool error recovery, citation discipline. Multi-turn discipline deferred to v6.1. Local-corpus discipline lives in agent-discipline.json.
